notes_en: Added a built-in lightweight update checker (pure native Swift + CryptoKit, zero extra dependencies, 0.0% idle CPU preserved)
Dual-region fast lookup racing GitHub and the official China HTTPS mirror with jsDelivr and GitHub API fallbacks
In-app DMG downloader with live progress, automatic channel fallback, and mandatory SHA-256 integrity verification before opening
Added Software Update controls in Settings → General, right-click Check for Updates, and a non-intrusive Popover update banner
notes_zh: 新增纯原生轻量级更新检测（基于 Swift URLSession 与 CryptoKit，零第三方更新框架，保持 0.0% 空闲 CPU）
支持 GitHub 与国内官网高速镜像（jclab.work）并发竞速检测，并自动回退 jsDelivr CDN 与 GitHub API
支持应用内实时进度下载、海外/国内通道自动故障切换，以及打开安装包前的强制 SHA-256 完整性校验
偏好设置「通用」页新增软件更新模块、右键菜单「检查更新」与控制中心非打扰式新版本提示条
